messages:
Maya (Support): Hey team, ACME (acct: acme-342) reported invoice #INV-2026-77 failing during checkout. Payment attempt hit 'declined' then 3DS challenge timed out. txn=tx_83f2
Ben (Payments): Can you paste the raw gateway response?
Maya (Support): Gateway returns: {"code":"card_declined","reason":"insufficient_funds","acquirer":"AcmePay","3ds":"challenge_required"} then client sees iframe timeout at 30s. Logs:
```
POST /v1/payments -> gateway 402
response: {"status":"declined","decline_code":"insufficient_funds"}
client error: SSE disconnected, 3ds iframe timeout 30000ms
```
Carlos (Platform Eng): Did the client complete JS redirect? Any CSP blocking iframe?
Maya (Support): Customer says iframe never rendered on Safari iOS 15. They tried Chrome desktop and saw challenge but challenge failed after 30s.
Dani (Fraud Ops): Risk signals look normal for cardholder; no velocity flags. I see acquirer returned '3DS_NOT_SUPPORTED' for a prior attempt.
Ben (Payments): Two possibilities: acquirer timed out on 3DS enrollment lookup, or our proxy dropped frames. Can ops pull gateway logs for tx_83f2 and the acquirer session id acq_774?
Carlos (Platform Eng): Pulling now. Also can we repro with curl + headless? Maya, can you add exact repro steps customer used?
Maya (Support): Steps they tried:
1) Click invoice link
2) Fill card, submit
3) modal opens then blank/timeout on mobile
They also have PO requirement on account; the invoice says PO# PO-990 but backend flagged missing PO in payload earlier then retried card. Payload: {"invoice":"INV-2026-77","po_number":"PO-990","amount":1250}
Ben (Payments): Ah — if our logic marks invoice as 'PO required' and blocks initial settle, it may trigger retry that reuses a stale 3DS session. That could cause acquirer to reject due to session mismatch.
Dani (Fraud Ops): Recommend a quick mitigation: disable auto-retry for PO-mismatch for this customer and advise manual retry or alternate card. I'll whitelist for ACME.
Carlos (Platform Eng): Found acquirer logs: acq_774 session expired after 28s with status 'NO_CHALLENGE', then a second authorize came with mismatch session_id. Will push a hotfix to prevent reusing session tokens on retry. ETA 2 hours.
Maya (Support): I'll tell customer: try desktop Chrome or add funds; meanwhile we'll disable retry. Thanks. :thumbsup:
InvoiceBot: auto-note: ticket #SUP-9001 updated by Maya.
Ben (Payments): Also adding a monitor to detect '3ds_session_reused' spikes.
Maya (Support): Closing loop with customer in ~30m.
